name: Lantern Hollow + Clearer Brin Sprite
description: Coach Brin's small overworld sprite is redesigned with a larger face, broader shoulders, a clear headlamp and scarf, and simpler blue shapes. All six 16×16 poses share a consistent 14-pixel-wide silhouette and foot baseline, matching the player better. His battle portrait and all village gameplay remain unchanged.
notes: Back up your normal cartridge save, select v1.10 and use CONTINUE. This revision changes only Brin's overworld pixel data and ROM checksums compared with v1.9; save layout, scripts, IDs, battle portrait and gameplay remain identical. Existing hall saves refresh his sprite on Continue. Older releases remain available. Numbered states remain tied to their exact ROM.
